description:
One call document parsing for invoices, receipts, statements, forms and scanned pages: PDF or image URL in, full text plus extracted fields out (dates, money amounts, totals/tax/amount due, invoice or order numbers, key: value pairs, emails, phones, URLs, simple tables). Images and scans use OCR. Price $0.006 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"kind":"pdf","pages":1,"characters":1840,"text":"INVOICE
Invoice #: INV-1042
Date: 2026-10-01
Total: $1,250.00","fields":{"dates":["2026-10-01"],"amounts":["$1,250.00"],"totals":[{"label":"total","value":"$1,250.00"}],"identifiers":["Invoice #: INV-1042"],"key_values":{"Invoice":"INV-1042","Date
